name: Water
summary: The current shelf now adds Chandler as an operating reclaimed-water and industrial comparator with measured municipal scale, completed treatment assets, and attributed operator metrics, while Phoenix TSMC project-specific reuse remains unproven.
watch_questions: Where does water availability decide whether a frontier project is locally possible?
